attempts.summary: On node1 (RHEL 10), built a local package repository from local storage and served it over HTTP via a systemd-managed python3 http.server bound to the node's own IP on port 8080, then made the usual remote RHEL repositories (Red Hat CDN, cdn.redhat.com) unreachable both in dnf config and at the network level, verified that unreachability, and installed the `tree` package purely from the local repo. Restarted node1 and confirmed the boot identity changed while the local repo service, installed package, and blocked-remote-repo state all persisted and recovered.
